sections.name: File setup, LoggedDecision
sections.title: Logged decision shape and header
sections.what: Describes one logged decision: the action taken, the reward, how likely that action was, and the two model guesses.
sections.why: Likely reason: each row needs these fields for the correction.
sections.watch_out: The propensity is the chance of action 1, since the other action's chance is one minus it.

sections.name: drEstimate
sections.title: Average estimate for one action
sections.what: Goes through each logged decision, takes the model's guess for the chosen action, and when the logged action matches adds the correction for the gap divided by the chance. Returns the average.
sections.why: Likely reason: combines the model guess and the correction, the standard method the header names.
sections.watch_out: A single row with a propensity at 0 or 1 throws, which stops the whole estimate.

summary: Estimates the average result that would have come from always taking one action, using past logged decisions and a correction for how often each action was chosen.
purpose: Lets the team judge a decision policy on past data before using it live.
why: The header says it is offline and stays accurate if either of two models is right.
how: Takes each logged decision, uses the model's guess for the action, adds a correction when the logged action matched, and averages over all decisions.
inputs: A list of logged decisions, each with the action taken (0 or 1), the reward, the propensity, and two model guesses.
risks: Any propensity at 0 or 1, or outside that range, throws. Very small propensities make the correction large and unstable.
debug: If the number looks extreme, check for propensities near 0 or 1. Empty input throws an error.
